agents.outsideChange: This profile changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept here; reload the saved profile before saving again.
agents.connectionReset: The connection changed. Unsupported permissions, approval switches and MCP selections were reset. Review the model and permissions before saving.
agents.mcpLimit: The maximum number of MCP servers is selected.
agents.description: Each profile is a role for pipeline steps: what the agent is for, the connection and model it runs on, and what it may do.
agents.emptyDetail: A profile is the role a pipeline step runs: what the agent is for, the connection and model it uses, and what it may do in the repository. Pipelines can use a profile once it is published.
agents.noConnections: Agents run on a project connection: an agent CLI such as Claude Code or Codex. Add a connection first, then create profiles.
agents.needsConnection: New agent needs a project connection.
agents.versionNote: Edits save as a draft. Publishing makes it the version new runs use; runs that already started keep theirs.
agents.stale: Draft based on v{{base}} · Published v{{version}}

agents.keepTitle: Publish this draft over the published version?
agents.firstNote: Pipelines can use this profile once v1 is published.
agents.emptyNote: Pipelines can use a profile once it is published.
agents.widenTitle: Allow these changes to the agent profile?
agents.failed: The profile could not be saved
agents.gone: This profile is no longer available.
agents.roleHint: Shown in pipelines, runs and approvals.
agents.responsibilityHint: One line on what this agent is for. People and planners read it.
agents.connectionHint: The agent CLI and what it runs on: a sign-in, or an API provider.
agents.modelHint: From the connection’s list, or Other model id… for one that isn’t listed.
agents.otherModelHint: Enter an id the connection accepts
agents.effortHint: CLI default leaves it to the connection’s own setting.

agents.askHint: Every command waits for your approval in Needs you.
agents.allowedHint: These run without asking. Anything else asks you first.
agents.anyHint: Runs without asking, confined to the task worktree.
agents.commandNote: Entries match by prefix: cargo test also allows cargo test -p api.
agents.networkHint: Package installs, web requests and git fetch.
agents.browserHint: Open, read and act in web pages through Orchester’s browser tools. Needs Network access.
agents.browserNeedsNetwork: Turn on Network access to give agents the browser.
agents.browserNotYet: Agents can use the browser once Orchester’s browser runs on this computer. You can’t watch their pages yet.
agents.allowedSitesHint: The agent opens and acts on these without asking. Any other site asks you first.

agents.mcpNone: This project has no MCP servers yet. Agents work without them.
